# jsQR 1.4.0

Decoder by Cosmo Wolfe and contributors, distributed under Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR/blob/master/dist/jsQR.js
Retrieved on 2026-10-23 from the upstream repository (package.json version 1.4.0).

The UMD export wrapper was replaced with an ES module export. The decoder is otherwise unchanged. The adjacent declaration describes the fields consumed by this application.

Bundled locally so scanning works without a CDN or an internet connection.
